periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree diagonal orientation relative to the sagittal facial plane of the upside-down head.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with an elongated visual ratio rather than a circular profile.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Tapering occurs towards the lateral edges of the face, creating a visual elongation from the geometric center of the patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct pinkish-red mark or abrasion is visible on the bridge of the snout between the periocular patches.
other_distinctive_markers: The upper teeth are fully exposed; the volar pads of both the left and right forepaws are visible due to the supine posture.
